title: Show submitted comments directly under the comment form

requirements.text: Update the Comments section UI so the submitted comments list is displayed as a comment section directly under the comment submission box (form), rather than appearing as a separate, visually distant block.

quotes: the comments should be shown as a comment section under the comment box

acceptanceCriteria: On the Comments section, the comment list renders immediately below the submission form area within the same visual flow (no large gap separating them).
The existing submit flow remains unchanged: submitting a comment clears the inputs and the newly submitted comment appears in the list after the posts query refreshes.
If there are no comments, the empty-state message is shown directly under the form.
Loading state for fetching comments is shown directly under the form.

constraints: Do not modify files under frontend/src/components/ui or any other immutable paths.
Keep the existing backend API and data model for posts unchanged (name + comment, existing length limits).
nonGoals: Do not add new fields to comments (e.g., timestamps, avatars beyond the existing initial).
Do not change Internet Identity/authentication behavior.
Do not redesign other site sections beyond what is necessary to place the comments list under the form.
